props.name: enableMnemonics
props.description: Enable Alt+key mnemonics while open. Defaults to true.

props.name: enableShortcuts
props.description: When true, keyboard shortcuts activate menu items while open. Defaults to true.

props.name: enableTypeAhead
props.description: Enable type-ahead letter matching while open. Defaults to true.

props.name: mnemonicVisible
props.description: When true, underline mnemonic access keys in labels.

props.name: optionKey
props.description: Passed from MenuBar for Option-key alternate accelerators.
